description.value: Better U Market is a health food and organic grocery store in the heart of Qualicum Beach, founded by local couple Mike and Regan after their own wellness journey. The shop carries fresh organic produce sourced from BC farmers alongside natural supplements, vitamins, and clean personal care products—all hand-selected to be free of additives and harmful chemicals. A touring cyclist stopping here will find genuine fresh-food resupply options in a community-focused setting that emphasizes local ingredients.

address.value: 149 Second Avenue West, Qualicum Beach, V9K 1S1

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack at 52m; rack at 70m.
